note: Each Old Testament book carries how close its oldest copy here comes to its writing; pick a book to see it. The New Testament books are dated only where this site's own timelines date them, so the four Gospels share one span and Acts, Hebrews, James and Jude are not on the chart yet. Old Testament dates are the Bible Knowledge Commentary's. Of the Second Temple writings, only those this site or the study notes date are placed; Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, 1 and 2 Maccabees, the Psalms of Solomon, the Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs and the halakhic midrashim wait for a Logos date.
